hooks.command: jq -r '"\(.title)\n\(.message)"' | { IFS= read -r title; IFS= read -r message; osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'display notification (item 2 of argv) with title (item 1 of argv) sound name "Glass"' -e 'end run' "$title" "$message"; }
osascript -e 'display notification "作業が完了しました。" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Glass"'
